This is an official romantic horror visual novel game created to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the character from 'Bloody Painter' and to give back to the fans for their support.

It is a spin-off based on the 2017 version of the story.

．2017 version of the story

．OVA'Winter'

．Official Website

此為慶祝《血腥畫家》角色創建10周年與回饋粉絲們的支持而製作的粉絲向官方恐怖戀愛視覺小說遊戲，是根據2017年版本的故事做的番外篇衍生。

．2017年版本故事

．OVA動畫「冬季」

．官方網站



🔪 Story 故事 🔪

You have unfortunately been captured by a serial killer, 

and you must increase your chances of survival within seven days.

Your choices will determine how he treats you and the outcome of your relationship.

What will your final relationship with him be...?

Will there be a change in the relationship between the killer and his prey?

你不幸的被殺人魔囚禁了起來，你必須在7天內提高存活率。

你的選擇會決定他對你的處置與你們最終的關係，你與他最終的關係會是……？

殺人魔與獵物之間的關係是否會產生變化呢？



⚠️ Content Warnings 內容警告 ⚠️

．This game contains some graphic scenes of violence.

．If you encounter a murderer, please call the police first.It's unrealistic to develop a romantic relationship with a murderer.

．This is a romance game♥

．本遊戲含部分血腥畫面描述。

．遇到殺人魔請先報警，想與殺人魔發展出浪漫關係是不切實際的。

．這是一款戀愛遊戲♥

 

🔪 Languages 語言 🔪

繁體中文 / 简体中文 / 日本語 / English / Pусский / Español / Português / Italiano

 

🔪 Features 特色 🔪

．Fully voiced.

．There are a total of 14 CG illustrations.

．全英文語音。

．總共有14張精美CG圖。

 

⏰ Estimated Play Time 遊戲時長 ⏰

40 minutes for an good ending.

完成一個好結局大約40分鐘。

 

🔪 Number Of Endings  結局數量 🔪

6 bad endings + 4 good endings.

6個壞結局 + 4個好結局。



🔴 Streaming Permission 直播許可 🔴

Feel free to stream and play this game live! If you encounter any bugs, please leave a comment to let us know.

歡迎直播遊玩本遊戲！同時若有遇到BUG請留言回報通知我們。

For players choosing the English language, it is recommended to go to settings and adjust the speed to the fastest.

選擇英文語言的玩家建議至設定將文本速度調整至最快。

 

🔪 Operating Systems 支援作業系統 🔪

⚠️If your operating system is Windows 11, you may encounter game crashes.

⚠️如果您的作業系統是Windows 11，您可能遇上遊戲閃退狀況。

Evelyn.htyz8 days ago(+1)(-2)

This game is really better than I thought. At first, I played it because I saw that it had the “Romance” tag. Even though it doesn’t have much 'jump scares' like other games, this is actually the first game that really made me feel creeped out and terrified because it involves human corpses.

In my opinion, the game gives a realistic Scene and Ending if u get involved with a serial killer ( It doesn’t mean I hate other romantic horror games, I LOVE all of them omg. It’s just that this game somehow feels more realistic, I don’t really know how to explain it.) Besides, after unlocking all the Endings, I thought it was just a normal game, until I found a box in the game and figured out its code. Then I found documents, videos, and more details about “BP.” It’s more than just a game tagged as horror, romance. There’s also so much more about BP’s background, past, and everything else.

In short, I don’t really know how to describe it properly. English isn’t my First language, so there may be some words that I used incorrectly. I just want to say that this game is truly amazing.
